purpose: R6.6 acceptance fixtures derived from fictitious Netherlands financial personas. Persona facts are kept separate from test-only assumptions so missing financial inputs are never presented as source facts.
rules: facts reproduce only information present in the persona workbook or its notes
assumptions exist only to exercise the calculator and are not claims about the persona
couple and family rows are not silently converted to household Box 1 income
automatic Box 1 is used only for the supported below-AOW ordinary-employment profile
unsupported or incomplete personas are acceptance boundaries rather than forced calculations
